summary: Onto Innovation supplies optical metrology, inspection and advanced-packaging lithography. Dated operating EV scenarios are USD 2.64bn downcycle, 5.87bn base and 10.23bn upside. They have no assigned probabilities or accepted per-share targets.
Onto Innovation 提供光学计量、检测及先进封装光刻。历史基准日经营企业价值为下行情景 26.43 亿、基准 58.67 亿、上行 102.32 亿美元；未赋予概率，也不是已认可每股目标价。
scope: 30 June 2026 cash-flow and capital origin; information through 18 October 2026. October discount inputs and later evidence make this a retrospective-information scenario, not a contemporaneous June estimate or current October valuation. Q2 is the latest report retained and reviewed here; live quarterly-page freshness was not independently verified.
现金流及资本基准日为 2026 年 6 月 30 日，信息截至 2026 年 10 月 18 日。十月折现参数及后续证据构成回溯信息情景，并非六月当时可知估计或十月当前估值。这里留存并审阅的最新报告为第二季；未独立核实实时季度页面的新鲜度。
growth: First forecast year ends June 2027: Q3 management revenue guidance midpoint 390 + analyst Q4 420 + analyst H1 2027 850 = USD 1,660m. Q3 revenue 380–400m and adjusted margin 31.5–32.5% remain guidance. Q4 and H1 2027 figures are analyst assumptions. The ten June-ending forecast periods are distinct from fiscal history.
首个预测年度截至 2027 年六月：第三季管理层收入指引中点 390，加分析假设第四季 420 及 2027 年上半年 850，合计 1,660 百万美元。第三季收入 380–400 百万美元及调整后利润率 31.5–32.5% 仍为指引。第四季及次年上半年为分析假设。十个六月结算预测期与历史财年不同。
profitability: Economic margins include fresh equity compensation: 4.2% of revenue initially, fading to 3.5%, with no duplicate future dilution. USD 59.4m legacy expense is displayed then identically reversed; legacy claims remain unresolved. Rent stays in operating costs. The retained 20bp occupancy-headroom stress lowers base EV by USD 46.39m to 5,820.83m; it is not measured incremental rent or lease debt.
经济利润率包含新增股权薪酬，成本从收入的 4.2% 降至 3.5%，不重复计入未来稀释。旧奖励费用 59.4 百万美元展示后等额转回，旧奖励请求权仍未确定。租金保留在经营成本中。留存的 20 基点场地成本压力情景将基准企业价值降低 46.39 至 5,820.83 百万美元；并非测得的增量租金或租赁债务。
funding: Every manual edit and simulation trial recomputes the selected funding policy. Years 1–5 require the greater of positive sales growth / sales-to-capital and physical cash capex less depreciation plus incremental working capital and operating cash. Years 6–10 fade to NOPAT × terminal growth / ROIC while retaining that floor. Entered investment is retained and topped up when needed. Terminal g/ROIC investment below its funding floor is rejected. Working capital and future cash capex are counted once; opening capital payables remain unresolved claims.
每次手工编辑及模拟试验均重新计算所选资金政策。前五年取正收入增量除以销售资本比和资金下限的较大值；下限包括现金资本开支减折旧、增量营运资本及经营现金。第六至十年向 NOPAT×终值增长率／ROIC 收敛，同时保留下限。保留输入投资，不足时补足。终值 g/ROIC 投资低于资金下限时拒绝计算。营运资本及未来现金资本开支只计一次；期初资本应付款仍是未确定请求权。
capital: Base funding uses sales-to-capital 1.4×, cash capex 3.0%, physical depreciation 1.8%, incremental NWC 40% and operating cash 3% of positive sales growth. Revenue declines receive no automatic working-capital release. Narrow historical capital/ROIC proxies are not comprehensive economic returns.
基准资金假设为销售资本比 1.4 倍、现金资本开支 3.0%、实物折旧 1.8%、增量营运资本占正收入增量 40%，经营现金占 3%。收入下降不自动释放营运资本。历史狭义资本及 ROIC 指标不代表完整经济回报。
tax: Operating tax fades from 15% to 21%. Temporary compensation tax benefits and acquisition effects are not perpetuated. Deferred-tax balances receive no automatic face-value credit; gross uncertain-tax benefits and recorded liabilities must not be deducted twice.
经营税率从 15% 过渡至 21%。不永久延续暂时薪酬税收优惠及收购影响。递延税余额不自动按账面值计入；不重复扣除未确认税收利益总额及已记录负债。
wacc: Base WACC fades from 10.97% to 9.51%. October 16 Treasury and October 1 ERP are different dated observations. Adjusted risk-free 4.87%, ERP 4.42% and sector beta 1.39 inform assumptions. The convertible zero coupon is not its economic debt cost.
基准 WACC 从 10.97% 降至 9.51%。十月十六日国债和十月一日 ERP 为不同日期观察。调整后无风险利率 4.87%、ERP 4.42% 及行业贝塔 1.39 为假设提供参考。可转债零息不代表经济债务成本为零。
terminal: Downcycle/base/upside terminal growth is 2.5% / 3.0% / 3.5%, with incremental funding ROIC 12% / 18% / 22%. These are assumed sustainable growth-funding returns, not measured company-wide returns. Final explicit and continuing investment meet g/ROIC and the physical/NWC/cash funding floor.
下行、基准、上行终值增长率为 2.5%／3.0%／3.5%，增量资金 ROIC 为 12%／18%／22%。这些是可持续增长资金回报假设，并非测得的全公司回报。最后预测年及持续经营投资满足 g/ROIC 和实物、营运资本、现金资金下限。
claims: June rounded common shares are 49.03m, distinct from July shares and diluted weighted shares. Cash/securities 1,882.15 less operating reserve 33.60, full June convertible fair value 1,982.25 and unpaid financing/excise costs 4.67 give USD −138.37m before other claims/assets. Do not also deduct principal/carrying value or add conversion shares. The terminated 500m bridge commitment is not funded debt.
六月报告的四舍五入普通股为 49.03 百万股，不同于七月股数及加权稀释股数。现金及证券 1,882.15，减经营储备 33.60、六月完整可转债公允价值 1,982.25 和未付融资及消费税成本 4.67，其他资产请求权前净额为 −138.37 百万美元。不再扣本金或账面债务，也不增加转换股数。已终止的 500 百万桥贷承诺不是已融资债务。
claimLimits: Common allocation stays unknown by default. Capped calls, legacy awards, ESPP, residual tax/capital/deferred-compensation claims and net FX economics remain unmeasured. USD 88.95m historical capped-call premium is not fair value. Illustrative USD 51.89 / 116.66 / 204.33 values are not accepted targets; USD 47.57 includes a separate 30% Rigaku cost haircut. Fixed convertible value is not intrinsic repricing. No current quote comparison is supported.
普通股分配默认保持未知。封顶看涨期权、旧奖励、ESPP、剩余税项及资本与递延薪酬请求权和净外汇经济价值尚未测定。历史封顶期权成本 88.95 百万美元不是公允价值。示例每股 51.89／116.66／204.33 美元并非已认可目标价；47.57 美元另含理学成本的 30% 折减。固定可转债价值不代表内在价值联立重估。不支持当前报价比较。
rigaku: The June-origin bridge pairs the later USD 720m purchase with a minority-asset value; their net June PV is unknown, and zero is only an at-cost illustration. Rigaku is not consolidated in forecast revenue. September 30 notice scheduled an October 1 transfer to wholly owned Onto Japan, retaining indirect ownership; completion was not independently established. It is not an external disposal or another purchase. Transfer-consent restrictions and minority rights do not prove unrestricted liquidity, control or intrinsic value.
六月基准日桥接须同时计入后续 720 百万美元购买付款及少数股权资产价值；其六月净现值未知，零仅为按成本示例。预测收入不合并理学业务。九月三十日公告计划十月一日转至全资 Onto Japan，保留间接所有权；未独立确认完成。这不是外部出售或另一次购买。转让同意限制及少数股东权利不能证明无限流动性、控制权或内在价值。
uncertainty: Fresh simulation defaults have zero width and are uncalibrated. Monte Carlo runs only on manual request. Zero-width trials reproduce the selected operating case, while common equity remains unavailable. Named scenarios have no assigned probabilities.
新模拟默认值为零宽度，尚未校准。蒙特卡洛仅手动运行。零宽度试验复现所选经营情景，普通股权益仍不可用。命名情景未赋予概率。
history: FY2016–2025 history retains field-level provenance and nulls. 2016–2018 are Rudolph predecessor, not standalone Nanometrics; 2019 contains only post-merger Nanometrics. Earlier shares are not a continuous denominator. Patent-litigation income affected 2016/2017 EBIT. FY2020 has 361 days; 2021/2025 are 53-week years. The rolling revenue anchor spans approximately 367 days. Original statements govern 2019–2021 sign/period conflicts. Original and merger-reclassified predecessor R&D remain distinct.

2016–2025 财年历史保留逐字段来源及空值。2016–2018 为 Rudolph 会计前身，不是独立 Nanometrics；2019 仅包含合并后 Nanometrics 期间。早期股数不可连续用作分母。专利诉讼收入影响 2016／2017 EBIT。2020 财年为 361 天，2021／2025 为 53 周。滚动收入基期约 367 天。2019–2021 的符号及期间冲突以原始年报为准。原始及合并重分类的前身研发数据分别保留。
